record.paper: A new class of graphs that satisfies the Chen-Chvátal Conjecture

dossier_meta.paper: A new class of graphs that satisfies the Chen-Chvátal Conjecture
dossier_meta.statement_text: There is a finite set of graphs $F_0$ such that every connected graph $G \notin F_0$ either has a pendant edge or satisfies $\ell(G) + \mathrm{br}(G) \geq |G|$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors observe that replacing a bridge by a path of arbitrary length in a counter-example to $\ell(G)+\mathrm{br}(G)\geq|G|$ yields infinitely many counter-examples, so finitely many minimal ones cannot account for all exceptions; they propose that graphs with a pendant edge should be excluded and that all remaining counter-examples come from a finite family.
